plan: Sell all SOXL and SPAL to eliminate leveraged ETFs.
Trim SPY to reduce concentration risk.
Increase QQQI to focus on income generation.
Reduce CRWD to lower tech concentration.
Buy MSFT to add a quality tech name.
This plan prioritizes capital preservation with reduced leverage.
conservative.read: This plan aims for lower, steadier returns around 1.5% per month. The focus is on reducing risk and preserving capital, accepting lower growth potential.

plan: Trim leveraged ETFs SOXL and SPAL to minimal levels.
Reduce SPY to address concentration.
Trim CRWD to diversify tech exposure.
Buy MSFT to add a strong tech name.
Add PLTR to capture high risk/reward setup.
This plan balances risk reduction with growth opportunities.
balanced.read: This plan targets around 2.5% monthly returns by balancing risk reduction with growth. It aims for steady progress while managing leverage and concentration.

plan: Increase leveraged ETFs SOXL and SPAL to capture upside.
Trim SPY to manage concentration.
Add to CRWD, a strong performer.
Buy MSFT to add a quality tech name.
Add PLTR for its high risk/reward setup.
Buy IONQ to add another high potential name.
aggressive.read: This plan targets aggressive growth around 4% per month, accepting significantly higher potential drawdowns. Leverage and concentration are used to maximize upside, but daily rebalancing of leveraged ETFs can cause decay and rapid losses.

plan: Sell all SOXL, SPAL, CRWD, and SMH to exit volatile positions.
Significantly increase QQQI to maximize income generation.
Trim SPY to reduce overall concentration.
Buy XLF to add exposure to the financial sector.
This plan prioritizes steady income and capital preservation.
income.read: This plan aims for lower, stable monthly income around 1% per month, focusing on capital preservation. While distributions are prioritized, NAV can still decline in market downturns.
